# Agenda

    - [Upgrade timelines](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#timelines)
         - After Pectra, we agreed to have a 30 day window between client releases and both the [first testnet fork](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#testnets) and [mainnet](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#mainnet). 
         - Assuming we followed this and wanted to deliver Fusaka before Devconnect, this implies: 
             - Mainnet ~> Nov 5-12
             - Last testnet ~> Oct 6-10
             - First testnet ~> Sep 22 - Oct 3
             - **Client testnet releases** ~> Week of Aug 25
